items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 15 October 2026 5:30am
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds, with gales at first.


##Wind)##

SW 6 or 7, occasionally gale 8 at first, veering W or NW 3 to 5 late morning.


##State of sea)##

Moderate or rough, becoming slight or moderate in the afternoon, then slight later.


##Weather)##

Rain soon, heavy at times, gradually clearing this afternoon. Fair later.


##Visibility)##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor in heavy rain, becoming good later.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 15°C
##Sea Temperature##

15°C
